description: Read a weekly payer follow-up with the account ID and the access token returned when it was started: whether payment is settled, each application's status (not_checked, received, in_review, needs_documents, approved with its effective date, denied, no_record, or no_decision when the checks stopped without a decision, with the date it can be reopened until), whether we write and submit it (work: write_and_submit, with submitted_on empty until it is submitted) or it was already submitted (work: follow_up), what we still need from you before we submit one we write (waiting_on_you), the payer's reference or representative, missing documents, the last and next check, check_every_days, and the log of every check (date, method, who checked, what the payer said, and how many reads found the same answer); the roster's changes from weekly monitoring; the deadlines within 30 and 90 days; and the status webhook (webhook: its url and updated_at, or null; never its secret).

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed status link.

name: payer_follow_up_status
title: Read a weekly payer follow-up
